Anything that is empty or starts with TODO counts as blank, and the matching button or section is hidden on the site.

Words in {curly brackets} are filled in for you, e.g. {onceOffBuild} becomes R7 500. The full list is in README.md.

Guests often find you on a booking site, then look you up on Google before they book. Returning guests and referrals do the same. If they find your own website with your rooms, rates and a 'Book direct' button, they can book there instead.
You don't have to leave the booking sites. Keep them for new guests, and let your website catch everyone who's already looking for you.

faq.q: What can a business tool do for me?
faq.a: It takes a job you do by hand and makes it quicker. For example:
list: A builder could send a neat quote from a phone in two minutes, then turn it into an invoice.
A salon could keep every client's colour formulas and notes in one place, instead of on paper cards.
A farm stall could take orders for collection without fifty WhatsApp messages.
A transport company could see every job, driver and delivery on one screen.

faq.a: Things like booking software, payment fees or SMS are paid by you, and we list them in your quote. Email hosting isn't included, but we can add it. Hosting and upkeep for a business tool is quoted with the tool.

seo.title: How It Works: From Quote to Go-Live | Front Door Sites
seo.description: How a project with Front Door Sites works: tell us what you need, get a free mock-up or plan and a fixed quote, pay a {deposit} deposit, approve, and go live.

startPage.lead: Here's exactly what happens, step by step.

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.text: Use the form, or send a WhatsApp, an email or a voice note. A few lines is enough.

steps.title: Get a free mock-up or plan, with a fixed quote
steps.text: For a website, a sample built from your public info. For a tool, a short written plan. Both come with a fixed price, valid for {quoteValidDays} days. A website quote shows the once-off price and the price with Care or Care Plus, so you can choose.

steps.title: Pay the {deposit} deposit
steps.text: That books your project in, and we start building.

steps.title: We build it, you approve it
steps.text: You see it as it takes shape and ask for changes until it's right. Send your logo, photos and prices when we ask for them.

steps.title: Pay the balance, and it goes live
steps.text: Pay the other {balance} once you've approved it. It goes live, and once it's paid in full, it's yours.

steps.title: After go-live: hosting and changes
steps.text: On once-off, the first year of hosting and your domain is included. After that, the renewal is {renewalFee} a year. On Care or Care Plus, your plan starts when your site goes live and runs for at least {minMonths} months.
noLinksText: We send you an invoice for each plan payment and each yearly renewal, and you pay by EFT.

startPage.timesNote: Counted from when your deposit and content reach us. Your quote gives the exact timeline.
